content.short: Indicaton is a creative studio and analytics tool on TON focusing on UI/UX and visual network identity.
content.description: Indicaton is a specialized creative studio and analytical project within the TON ecosystem, focused on defining the visual identity and user experience of decentralized applications. It provides a range of tools and design frameworks that help developers build more intuitive and visually appealing dApps, contributing to the overall usability of the network. Indicaton also offers analytical insights into design trends and user engagement across TON, serving as a vital partner for projects looking to optimize their visual presence and effectively onboard users through high-quality UI/UX design.
content.meta: Optimize your dApp design with Indicaton on TON. Creative tools and insights on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
